description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1670/28, Moratuwa D/S Division - Cad. Map No. 520201 and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title amendments and corrections under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries modifying land parcel numbers, extents, and particulars for specific land plots in various locations (Rawathawaththa, Moratumulla, Indibedda) with detailed cadastral references. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and involves land registration matters handled by the Commissioner of Title Settlement, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
